subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Let us __assume__ that we will do the job honestly.
solution:
The correct answer is: **think**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"assume"** means to suppose something to be the case, without proof. (मान लेना)

 
 
• **Example:** I assume you have completed the assignment.
 
 
 
• **"Think"** refers to the process of considering or reasoning about something. (सोचना)
 
 
• **Example:** I think we should leave early to avoid traffic.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'assume'** is **'think'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **think**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Give** (देना): To present voluntarily and without expecting compensation.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to give her old clothes to charity.
 
 
 
• **Take** (लेना): To acquire possession, control, or occupancy of.
 
 
• **Example:** Please take a seat.
 
 
 
• **Allow** (अनुमति देना): To let someone do something or let something happen.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher allowed the students to leave early.
 
 

3c:Tc75,

The correct answer is: Option 3
